propositions: Contributor guidance documents hardcode a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) for DCO sign-off instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity, contradicting the project policy in CONTRIBUTING.md
Multiple guidance files (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md) prescribe the same personal bot identity as the canonical sign-off, creating inconsistency and confusion for contributors
A deterministic lint-integrated check must be added to detect and prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off identities in contributor-facing documentation

Joe Oakhart's bot identity should be retained only in automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/) and experiment corpora (docs/experiments/), explicitly excluded from the consistency check
